description: Retrieves detailed product information for a given product page URL. Returns product metadata, supported checkout modes (canCheckout: login / guest), variant dimension names (e.g. Color, Size), and per-variant price, availability, image, attributes, and monetizationUrl.

allVariants.description: When true, returns all available variants for the product

url.description: Full product page URL to fetch details for

name: get_product_details
